evidence_items.explanation: Microsoft identifies infrastructure spending beyond short-lived equipment. This cautions against treating total capex as GPU purchases, but does not establish the amount or age of idle GPUs.

unresolved_gaps: No independently substantiated valuation approaching $200 billion of purchased GPUs awaiting powered deployment was obtained.
No purchase-cohort evidence establishes multi-year idle periods for the claimed spending.
Total infrastructure expenditure cannot identify idle GPU purchases.
No evidence establishing deliberate concealment was obtained.
